_comment: pagent phase 2: the three turn-terminal sentences the agent-steps box renders when a turn stops for a reason the user must be told about (no-route, no-proposal, unknown-tool). legCapSentence and interrupted already shipped in _pagent-fragments.json; these three had no rendering at all until the terminal was plumbed through. Each locale reuses its OWN existing 'ask again to carry on' clause from legCapSentence verbatim, so the four terminal sentences read as one voice. no-proposal is deliberately not an apology: Mera understood the turn and had nothing to add, which is a normal answer.
